description: Synthetic bilingual engineering regression fixture. Labels are authored topic matches; not a production relevance sample.

documents.text:
Attention mechanisms
Transformers use self attention to compare tokens and aggregate contextual representations. Multihead attention assigns separate learned projections to different relationships. Positional encodings carry sequence order without recurrence.

Attention mechanisms
自注意力比较序列中的词元并聚合上下文表示。多头注意力利用不同投影学习不同关系，位置编码提供顺序信息，无需循环网络。

Retrieval augmented generation
Retrieval augmented generation searches an external document collection before producing an answer. Retrieved passages ground language model responses in source evidence. Citations link generated claims to the supporting documents.

Retrieval augmented generation
检索增强生成先从外部文档集合寻找相关段落，再让语言模型回答。检索证据为答案提供依据，引用将结论连接到原始文献。

Database transactions
Serializable transactions isolate concurrent database updates. Commit records atomic changes, while rollback discards partial writes. Write conflicts are detected so that failed attempts can be retried without violating invariants.

Database transactions
可串行化事务隔离并发数据库更新。提交原子地保存更改，回滚丢弃部分写入。检测写冲突并重试能保持约束与数据一致性。

Distributed consensus
Consensus protocols replicate an ordered log across servers. A leader proposes entries and a majority quorum acknowledges them. Election terms prevent an obsolete leader from committing conflicting changes.

Distributed consensus
共识协议在多个服务器间复制有序日志。领导者提议日志项，多数派确认后提交，选举任期阻止旧领导者写入冲突更改。

Model quantization
Integer quantization compresses neural network weights from floating point to eight bit values. Per channel scales reduce numerical error. CPU inference trades small accuracy changes for lower memory bandwidth and latency.

Model quantization
整数量化把神经网络浮点权重压缩为八位整数。逐通道缩放减少数值误差，在较小精度变化下减少CPU推理的内存带宽和时延。

Reinforcement learning
A reinforcement learning agent chooses actions and observes delayed rewards. Policy gradients optimize expected return from sampled trajectories. Exploration discovers useful actions that a greedy policy might miss.

Reinforcement learning
强化学习智能体选择动作并观察延迟奖励。策略梯度用采样轨迹优化期望回报，探索可以发现贪心策略遗漏的有效动作。

Graph neural networks
Graph neural networks propagate messages between neighboring nodes. Aggregating local neighborhoods yields representations of network structure. Permutation invariant pooling permits node order to change without changing the graph prediction.

Graph neural networks
图神经网络在相邻节点之间传播消息，聚合局部邻域以表示网络结构。置换不变池化使节点排序变化不会改变图的预测结果。

Contrastive embeddings
Contrastive learning brings semantically related texts closer in embedding space and separates unrelated examples. Multilingual encoders align meanings across languages. Cosine similarity ranks normalized vectors for semantic retrieval.

Contrastive embeddings
对比学习拉近语义相关文本的向量，分离不相关样本。多语言编码器对齐不同语言的含义，用余弦相似度对归一化向量排序以进行语义检索。

Diffusion models
Diffusion image generation gradually corrupts training images with noise. A neural denoiser learns to reverse each corruption step. Sampling begins with random noise and iteratively reconstructs a coherent image.

Diffusion models
扩散模型训练时逐步向图像加入噪声，神经网络学习逆向去噪过程。采样从随机噪声开始，迭代重建连贯图像。

PDF text extraction
PDF text extraction reconstructs reading order from glyph coordinates and page geometry. Multicolumn layouts and ligatures can corrupt naive extraction. Exact source offsets allow highlights to point back to the original passage.

PDF text extraction
PDF文本提取根据字形坐标和页面几何重建阅读顺序。多栏排版与连字会干扰简单提取，准确的原文偏移使高亮能够定位回证据段落。

Work queue scheduling
A scheduler admits background work according to available memory and CPU. Interactive tasks receive reserved capacity. Aging gives a waiting batch a bounded opportunity while preventing repeated launch and preemption cycles.

Work queue scheduling
调度器根据可用内存和CPU接纳后台任务，为交互任务保留容量。等待老化让批处理获得有界机会，避免反复启动又抢占的循环。

Durable job results
A worker uploads an immutable result artifact and submits a small manifest. A database inbox accepts it atomically. Execution generations reject stale workers and replaying the receipt avoids recomputing paid external work.

Durable job results
工作进程上传不可变结果文件并提交小型清单，数据库收件箱原子接收。执行代次拒绝过期工作进程，重放回执避免重复执行付费外部工作。

Browser virtualization
A virtualized document reader keeps nearby pages rendered and releases distant canvases. Stable placeholders preserve scroll geometry. Protecting selected text and cancelling obsolete searches reduces memory growth without breaking interaction.

Browser virtualization
文档阅读器虚拟化只保留邻近页面并释放远处画布，稳定占位维持滚动几何。保护所选文本和取消过期搜索可控制内存增长且不破坏交互。

Async HTTP lifetimes
An asynchronous HTTP client reuses connections owned by one event loop. Reusing the pool from another closed loop causes failures. Database transactions should finish before network I/O and client shutdown should use the owning loop.

Async HTTP lifetimes
异步HTTP客户端复用属于同一事件循环的连接。跨已关闭的循环使用连接池会失败，网络请求前应结束数据库事务，并在原循环关闭客户端。

Statistical evaluation
Retrieval evaluation ranks candidate documents against graded relevance judgments. Recall measures whether relevant documents are found within the first results. Discounted cumulative gain rewards placing highly relevant evidence earlier.

Statistical evaluation
检索评估利用分级相关性标注检验候选文档排序。召回率衡量前若干结果是否找回相关文档，折损累计增益奖励把高度相关证据排在前面。

Access isolation
Authorization filters restrict documents to their permitted readers before semantic ranking. Private annotations remain scoped to their creator. Changing group membership must invalidate stale access without exposing hidden content through search.

Access isolation
授权过滤在语义排序前把文档限制为读者可访问范围，私人批注保持作者隔离。成员关系变化必须使旧权限失效，避免搜索泄露隐藏内容。
